title: B-linear cohomological counit shift square
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings in one universe, A and B R-algebras, and suppose the R- and B-module derived categories exist. Let derived:D(R)→D(B) have coherent integer shifts, and let counit:Qh composed with derived→ordinary extension R→B composed with Qh be a natural transformation commuting with these shifts. No universal property, tensor-algebra action, or localization algebra is assumed. For A-module cochain complexes K,L, an integer n, an isomorphism e:L≅K[-n], and an integer j, supply the ordinary tensor isomorphisms for K and L sending b tensor x to (1 tensor b) tensor x. Put S=restriction A→R, G=termwise extension R→B, F=termwise extension A→E for E=A tensor_R B, U=restriction E→B, and D=S composed with the homotopy quotient, Qh, and derived. Let delta:H^j(D L)≅H^(j-n)(D K) be obtained from D(e), its shift comparison and the derived homology shift. Let epsilon:H^j(F L)≅H^(j-n)(F K) be obtained from F(e), its shift comparison and the cochain homology shift. For X=K in degree j-n and X=L in degree j, let c_X be the B-linear morphism from derived homology to U of ordinary E-homology formed by homology of counit, the Qh and homotopy homology factorization maps, homology of the supplied ordinary tensor isomorphism, and the restriction/homology isomorphism. Then delta.hom followed by c_K equals c_L followed by U(epsilon.hom).

proof.text: Apply ShiftedHom.map_naturality to e.hom and the whiskered counit, followed by derived homology shiftMap. The supplied NatTrans.CommShift instance gives shifted naturality. Reassociate and use homology shift naturality to obtain shiftHomology_nat. Whisker counit with restriction and quotient and the mapHomotopyCategoryFactors and associator isomorphisms; its component is exactly counit, since the other components are identities.

Use DerivedCategory.shiftMap_homologyFunctor_map_Qh and HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor_shiftMap. Their factorization isomorphisms compose to rho. Compose with rho.hom to cancel rho.inv and identify the shifted derived homology map with rho.hom followed by the ordinary cochain homology shiftMap. Compose this identity with shifted counit naturality to get hbase.

Use ExtendScalars.hom_ext in each degree to prove the tensor square ho: both sides send 1 tensor x to includeRight(1) tensor e(x), by the supplied generator equations and ExtendScalars.map_tmul. B-linearity determines every tensor. Apply cochain homology shiftMap and its two composition lemmas to obtain hO.

The closed WeilConjectures exact-functor lemma mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso_hom_app_shiftIso and naturality give restriction_shiftMap_homology. Identify its homology natural-isomorphism components with the short-complex mapHomologyIso components. Apply this to restriction E to B and F(e), and compose with hO to get hordinary. Compose hbase with hordinary and reassociate to obtain the displayed boundary square. No sorry remains.

theorem baseDerivedTensor_counit_shift_square
    (derived : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B))
    [derived.CommShift ℤ]
    (counit : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derived ⟶
      (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh)
    [NatTrans.CommShift counit ℤ]
    (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (n : ℤ) (e : L ≅ K⟦-n⟧) (j : ℤ)
    (ordinaryIsoK :
      ((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≅
      ((restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj K))
    (ordinaryIsoK_tmul : ∀ (k : ℤ) (b : B) (x : K.X k),
      ordinaryIsoK.hom.f k (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] x) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)] x)
    (ordinaryIsoL :
      ((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L) ≅
      ((restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj L))
    (ordinaryIsoL_tmul : ∀ (k : ℤ) (b : B) (x : L.X k),
      ordinaryIsoL.hom.f k (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] x) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)] x) :
    let S := (restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let U := restrictScalars.{u}
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom
    let πR := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)
    let πB := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ)
    let D := S ⋙ πR ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derived
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B)
    let δ := (H j).mapIso (D.mapIso e ≪≫ (D.commShiftIso (-n)).app K) ≪≫
      ((H 0).shiftIso (-n) j (j - n) (by omega)).app (D.obj K)
    let ε := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B))
      (.up ℤ) j).mapIso (F.mapIso e ≪≫ (F.commShiftIso (-n)).app K) ≪≫
      (CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B)) (-n) j (j - n)
        (by omega)).app (F.obj K)
    let cK := (H (j - n)).map (counit.app (πR.obj (S.obj K))) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B) (j - n)).hom.app
        (πB.obj (G.obj (S.obj K))) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) (j - n)).hom.app
        (G.obj (S.obj K)) ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ordinaryIsoK.hom (j - n) ≫
      (((F.obj K).sc (j - n)).mapHomologyIso U).hom
    let cL := (H j).map (counit.app (πR.obj (S.obj L))) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B) j).hom.app
        (πB.obj (G.obj (S.obj L))) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) j).hom.app
        (G.obj (S.obj L)) ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ordinaryIsoL.hom j ≫
      (((F.obj L).sc j).mapHomologyIso U).hom
    δ.hom ≫ cK = cL ≫ U.map ε.hom
